The weighted cloud reliability calculator achieved a perfect reward score by successfully passing all integrated pytest validation suites.
The run achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.86, with zero exceptions across all trials. Pytest version 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.30s. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check edge case handling for zero-weight inputs to ensure the 1.00 mean reward remains stable.
